summary: The native sync engine is now the default: Nextcloud and OpenCloud synchronize without nextcloudcmd or opencloudcmd.
changelog: Every account uses the native Rust engine. Existing configurations move over once, and turning the switch off in Settings still falls back to the external command line client.
The first run on an account synchronized by the old client records what matches, keeps differences as conflicted copies and deletes nothing.
The setup wizard no longer requires the external client to finish, and the folder menu only offers to install it for accounts that opted out.
